nodes.relation: H128 abstracts the missing global quotient into a universal residual equivalence relation and strengthens it with continuation and witness-recovery completeness.
H129 drops the impossible requirement to classify every residual and requires only the states actually selected by one explicit total-work algorithm.
H130 fixes one concrete no-cache descendant, replaces abstract quotient arguments by a proof-emitting execution, and connects it to the MAJ3 Res(⊕) lifting theorem.
H131 separates exact formula caching from ordinary proof-DAG reuse and makes the missing proof-system classification itself the next theorem.

design_rule: C020 admits the Tear line only after preserving its terminal counterexamples and splitting selected-state algorithms into no-cache and formula-caching proof systems.
